About AAYWA

Where women grow, communities flourish.

AAYWA is an African NGO empowering young women to move beyond subsistence farming into profitable, sustainable agribusiness — giving them ownership, knowledge, leadership and a place in the global economy.

Vision

Transforming the lives of young African women from subsistence farming to sustainable agribusiness.

Mission

Empowering young African women to build profitable, sustainable agribusinesses through training, finance, innovation, global markets and ethical value chains — while developing leaders who create lasting change.

Discover AAYWASee how we work
“

We do not measure transformation by training alone. We follow the journey from opportunity to enterprise, and from enterprise to leadership.

A belief that shapes AAYWA
Explore our impact story

The challenge

Turning barriers into pathways.

Young women across Africa hold enormous potential in agriculture. Yet systems — not ability — often stand between them and sustainable enterprise: capital, markets, training, technology, climate and representation. AAYWA exists to turn those barriers into pathways.

  • Limited access to capital

    Finance & investment readiness

  • Weak market connections

    Reliable, ethical market access

  • Inadequate business training

    Practical agribusiness education

  • Lack of technology

    Digital & indigenous innovation

  • Climate risks

    Climate-smart, regenerative farming

  • Post-harvest losses

    Processing & value addition

  • Limited representation

    Leadership & mentorship pathways

  • Limited access to international markets

    Ethical value chains & global buyers

Our work

Six pillars. One journey to enterprise.

AAYWA works across the full journey of women-led agribusiness development — from the first seed of knowledge to leadership in global markets.

The AAYWA journey

From discovery to leadership.

A supported pathway that grows with every woman — built to carry her from a first step into agriculture to leading an enterprise that transforms her community.

  1. Step 01

    Discover

    Young women identify their potential, interest and opportunity in agribusiness.

  2. Step 02

    Learn

    They gain practical skills in farming, business and leadership.

  3. Step 03

    Produce

    Climate-smart, regenerative production begins on the farm.

  4. Step 04

    Build

    Enterprises take shape with plans, records and strong foundations.

  5. Step 05

    Access Markets

    Products reach reliable local, regional and global markets.

  6. Step 06

    Grow

    Revenue, confidence and impact compound over time.

  7. Step 07

    Lead

    Women become mentors, employers and community leaders.

Our impact

Strong women. Stronger farms. Stronger communities.

AAYWA measures success through the social, economic and environmental change created around women-led agribusiness.

Social Impact

Skills, confidence, mentorship, leadership and stronger livelihoods.

Economic Impact

Greater productivity, stronger enterprises, employment and access to markets.

Environmental Impact

Regenerative agriculture, soil health, resource efficiency and climate resilience.

Our values

The principles behind every programme, partnership and decision.

Eight values guide how AAYWA shows up — with the women we serve, the partners we work with and the change we pursue.

Sisterhood

We rise through shared growth, solidarity and collective success.

Leadership

We equip women to lead boldly and influence change.

Indigenous Innovation

We honour African knowledge and combine it with modern solutions.

Sustainability

We protect natural resources while building resilient livelihoods.

Empowerment

We build confidence, ownership and economic independence.

Advocacy

We amplify young women's voices and champion equitable opportunity.

Partnerships

We believe lasting impact grows through strong ecosystems.

Well-being

We connect agriculture with nutrition, wellness and thriving communities.

Get involved

Grow with AAYWA.

Whether you are a young woman farmer, mentor, buyer, researcher, funder or institutional partner — there is a place for you in AAYWA's ecosystem.

  • Join as a Young Woman FarmerBecome part of an AAYWA programme and take the first step from farming to enterprise.
  • Become a MentorShare your experience in agriculture, business or finance with the next generation of women leaders.
  • Partner With AAYWACollaborate with us on programmes, research, ecosystems and lasting-system change.
  • Support Our ProgrammesFund or enable women-led agribusinesses and the communities they transform.
  • Become a Market PartnerSource quality products from women-led agribusinesses and join an ethical value chain.
  • Collaborate on ResearchPartner with AAYWA on evidence, data and insight around women in African agriculture.
